content.title: Chapter 54 - MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC — Sec. 54-93. - Use or operation prohibited.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to use or operate an unlicensed motor vehicle
               upon city-owned land. Nothing in this article prohibits the operation of golf cars
               on golf courses located within the city.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 1, 8-29-2016
; Ord. No.
4772
, § 6, 8-16-2021…
